files.text: --- title: "Remove a video background" description: "Cut a person or any object out of a clip or picture so titles can pass behind them: in the Studio app with a right-click, or free on your computer with one command." sidebarTitle: "Remove background" --- import { DocsVideo } from "/snippets/docs-video.jsx"; Cut a person out so titles can pass behind them, lift an object out of a shot, or replace what's behind. The basic cut-out runs on your computer: no upload, no account, no cost. *A presenter cut out of a real room, with the hard edges (hair, a shoulder a plant overlapped) magnified.* ## In the Studio app Right-click a video or picture in the preview: - **Cut out object here** lifts out whatever you clicked, a person or a thing. On a video it follows that object through the clip. Shift-click adds to the selection; on a picture, **B** brushes the edges. It runs on a Mac: pictures on Apple silicon with macOS 14 or later, or Intel with macOS 13.3 or later; video on Apple silicon only. - **Remove background** keeps the person and drops the rest. It's free and runs on your computer, made for people on plain backgrounds. With a HeyGen API key you can choose a cloud cut through HeyGen instead, paid from your API balance. Or just ask: "put the title behind her", "remove the cup from the table", "put her on a rainy street at night". ## On the command line ```bash npx hyperframes remove-background subject.mp4 -o subject.webm ``` The first run downloads the model; it needs FFmpeg. Pick the output by where it goes: `.webm` for HyperFrames and the web, `.mov` (ProRes 4444) for Premiere, Resolve or Final Cut, `.png` for a single photo. For text behind the person, make the cut-out and a background plate with a person-shaped hole in one pass, then stack: plate, your text or graphic, cut-out on top. ```bash npx hyperframes remove-background subject.mp4 -o subject.webm --background-output plate.webm ``` ## When it works, and when it won't The free model is made for people: a clear subject, steady framing, some contrast with the background. Expect trouble with a held object (a dark mic or phone can vanish), fine hair over a busy background, and fast motion. For objects, use **Cut out object here** in the app instead. ## Fixes, quality and speed | Problem | What to check | | --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | The background is still opaque | Confirm the output is transparent WebM, MOV, or PNG and preview it over a colored background. | | Edges flicker | Use a cleaner source, reduce fast movement, or use a stronger external matting tool. | | Processing is slow | Check `--info`; CPU processing works but is much slower than an available accelerated provider. | | The subject has a color halo | Use `--quality best`, especially when layering over the original source. | | The “background plate” has a hole | Expected: it is inverse alpha, not an inpainted clean plate. | | Part of a held object is missing | The model matches people, not what they hold. Use another matting tool for that shot. | `--quality best` for a cut-out over its own original footage, `fast` for a smaller file over something unrelated; `--info` shows whether a fast local processor was found. To move the cut-out, animate a wrapper around the video, not the video itself. Every flag is in the [CLI reference](/packages/cli#remove-background). ## Related topics - [Add an AI avatar presenter](/guides/avatar-presenter) - [Use images and video](/guides/video-components) - [Apply media effects](/guides/media-effects)
